card.name: News attribution after a quote
card.fires_on: Words right after a quoted speaker in news-style web text, such as 'in a statement', 'at a briefing', or the period ending a quote's attribution. Also fires on a few odd spots like a famous name after a list.

modes.label: Attribution phrase
modes.description: The words 'in', 'a', or 'statement' in 'said X, in a statement/briefing'.
modes.example: said Mike Watkins, Curiosity mission manager at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory,<< in>> a briefing today.

modes.label: Sentence end after claim
modes.description: A period closing a sentence of reported speech or a factual claim, before the next sentence.
modes.example: Williams says<<. >>All told, the nonpartisan Tax

modes.label: Name in a list
modes.description: A first name within a list of celebrities.
modes.example: the George Clooneys of the world,<< LeBron>> James, the CEOs

card.plain: It marks the spot in a news story where a quoted source is being credited or a sentence is wrapping up.
